new_defect_N5.title: first/1st name-side divergence: ADDR_CANON_COMMON has first->1st, NAME_CANON has no ordinal entry

code_evidence.addr_side: normalize.py:184 ADDR_CANON_COMMON contains first->1st, second->2nd, third->3rd, fourth->4th, fifth->5th; consulted at normalize.py:347 inside normalize_address
code_evidence.name_side: normalize.py:109-142 NAME_CANON (34 lines, read in full) contains NO ordinal entry; consulted at normalize.py:281 inside _name_tokens

new_defect_N5.key_mechanism: keys.py:33-34 builds name keys from LEET/canon-processed ncore; keys.py:39-43 builds address keys from raw atoks; the kind-0 key at keys.py:60 XORs the two (th ^ (ah // 2)) so it can only form when a name token and an address token agree. features.py:128-129 uses SEPARATE idf tables (name_idf vs addr_idf), so the address side can never rescue the name side.
new_defect_N5.guard_note: Even WITH the guard applied, name-side 1st (679) and name-side first (61068) are still two different tokens. The guard fixes the corruption, not the divergence. Necessary but not sufficient.
new_defect_N5.cross_check_D084: D084 (c03) independently measured that first->1st is NOT in the no-fusion canon class, because 1st occurs 16478 times on the US address side. That confirms the address half of the pipeline works; the defect is the missing mirror in NAME_CANON. Not in tension with D084 do-not-extend verdict.
new_defect_N5.explicitly_not_proposed: No NAME_CANON edit is proposed as part of the LEET fix. NAME_CANON is consulted at :281 AFTER translate at :280, so an ordinal entry there would only ever see already-leeted tokens. Different table, different risk surface.

powershell_gotcha: A @{} hashtable keyed on a numeric-looking token such as 149 AUTO-COERCES the key to Int64, and -cmatch then silently returns $false. My first three family scans reported 0 US name-side types for every family, which is obviously wrong given 24hr is in hand. Fix: prefix every key with _ and strip on read. All numbers here use the prefixed form.
limits: Top-4000 truncation: every type list is a FLOOR. 8-18% of name-token mass is outside the window (D121 coverage table). Every 0-type result means not in the measured window, never does not occur.
Truncation is not uniform across files: train_s1 and test_s1 each expose only 1 US mixed type. Single-file reads are UNSAFE for this question; the six-file union recovers all 133.
Token OCCURRENCES, not rows. No row count is quoted for any finding. Per-row impact of the 4336 US corruptions is NOT derivable from this profile.

build_profile.py:111,127 applies TOKEN_RE [a-z0-9]+ to the raw lowercased string with NO accent stripping, and computes addr_tokens per comma-component (:126-127) then sums. Component structure is not visible.
ADDR_CANON_COMMON is not applied by the profiler, so us_addr_occ.first=15800 is the RAW count. The post-canon figure 32278 is an INFERENCE from reading normalize.py:347.
No raw TSV was read (hard constraint). Nothing is verified against source rows.
